summary: Durable publication-operation ledger (cinatra#1450, epic #1448). Adds one brand-new table, artifact_publication_operations: draftable artifacts (social post drafts, ads drafts, email bodies) publish through a durable OPERATION record — never directly; queue jobs are DELIVERY, not authority. Each row pins the exact representation revision to publish (pinned_representation_revision_id — representation capture must exist before the ledger can pin it), the destination (destination_connector/account/ref), the due time (due_at; 'publish now' = an immediately-due operation), the attempt + idempotency_key (derived from the external-publish identity org/artifact/pinned-revision/destination and handed VERBATIM to the delivery/connector call so a redelivery cannot double-publish), the cancellation_generation fence (bumped on cancel; a stale delivery for a prior generation is rejected at the pending->running claim), and the operation state (pending -> running -> succeeded | failed | cancelled). CONSTRAINTS the DB enforces: artifact_publication_operations_idempotency_uniq is a partial UNIQUE (org_id, idempotency_key) WHERE state <> 'cancelled' — at most one live-or-succeeded operation per external-publish identity (the no-double-publish backstop); a cancelled operation frees the slot so an edit-after-unschedule can re-schedule. state/attempt/cancellation_generation CHECKs mirror the project_dispatch_attempts precedent. NO foreign keys on purpose (the artifact_uninstall_operations / dispatch-ledger precedent): durable history outlives artifact deletion and representation-table evolution; the pinned revision + artifact ids are validated at WRITE time (schedule refuses a non-existent revision), not FK-enforced at rest. The artifact's scheduled/published status and receipts are a projection written only via the ledger's transitions (the #1449 mutability trusted commands), through an injected status port so this substrate never imports the sibling's unmerged surface. Additive/NON-destructive: a brand-new empty table + five indexes; no NOT NULL on existing data, no unique index on an existing table, no retype, no tightened constraint, no data rewrite. Mirrors the idempotent bootstrap DDL in src/lib/drizzle-store.ts (buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries -> publicationOperationLedgerSchemaQueries leaf src/lib/artifacts/publication-operation-schema.ts, spread in the SAME PR) so fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade stay aligned (core__0037/0047 precedent). down() drops the table (fresh addition; exact pre-0055 shape on any lineage; publication-operation history is not re-derivable but the projected artifact status is). SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0054 (assistant-template-principal-link); a concurrent lane may claim 0055 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
